findings.summary: Log-scrub tests do not wire createLogCapture into the production pino destination; only the helper is exercised. Acceptance bullet 8 is not verified end-to-end.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend buildApp to accept an injected logger (or destination) and pass createLogCapture().destination, run real login/refresh/me/logout, then call capture.notContainsAny([SEED_PLAINTEXT, sessionValue, refreshValue, csrfValue]). The current test would still pass if production redact paths were removed.

findings.summary: vi.hoisted env-seed block plus the lazy-getter vi.mock for db/client is copy-pasted verbatim into all 11 integration test files; any env-contract change requires 11 edits.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract a shared `apps/api/test/support/setup.ts` exporting setupTestEnv() and the db/client mock factory; import once per test file. Reduces 11 copies to one source of truth.

findings.summary: Replay-warn test asserts logger.warn called once and that the payload has userId/requestId keys but does not assert the log message equals 'refresh.replay_detected'; weakens bullet 12.
findings.suggested_fix: Augment the warnCalls[0] assertion to check warnArg.msg (or warnCalls[0][1]) contains 'replay' or matches the literal 'refresh.replay_detected' so a regression that silently changes the message would still fail the test.

findings.summary: loginPatient/loginAs helpers are repeated with the same shape across 6+ integration files; consider hoisting to support/.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `loginAs(app, email, password?)` to apps/api/test/support/request.ts and replace the per-file copies in refresh/me/logout/csrf/token-family/concurrent-refresh tests.

findings.summary: Sad-path 'returns non-200 when no refresh cookie is present' only asserts not 200/201 (test output shows real status is 422); too loose to catch contract drift.
findings.suggested_fix: Tighten to expect(res.status).toBe(422) and expect(body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION') so a regression that swapped 422 for 401 or 500 would fail.

findings.summary: Test seeds a valid JWT_SECRET via vi.hoisted and calls loadEnv() directly instead of the task-prescribed buildApp({ ...env, JWT_SECRET: 'too-short' }); symptom of the eager-load singleton in shared/env.ts.
findings.suggested_fix: Track in retro: convert shared/env.ts to lazy getEnv() or accept env into buildApp constructors (per project_env_eager_load memory). Then this test can exercise buildApp directly as bullet 10 intends.

findings.summary: Test re-implements seed insert logic locally (runSeed) instead of invoking apps/api/src/seed/main.ts; a regression in main.ts (e.g. dropped ON CONFLICT) would not be caught by this test.
findings.suggested_fix: Refactor apps/api/src/seed/main.ts to export a pure `seedUsers(db)` and have main() call it then pool.end(); import seedUsers in the test rather than duplicating the insert SQL.
